These are synthetic migration fixtures, not user saves. Do not copy them over a real save.

v02.sav was produced by the v0.2 serializer. It contains 54,321 test credits, a selected Gullwing with engine/wheel/decal ownership, one nitro upgrade and legacy preferences.

v03.sav was produced by the unchanged v0.3 serializer. It contains 4,321 test credits, a selected Gullwing and three engine-tune upgrades.

Tests verify that v0.4 preserves the original data and initializes the twelve new vehicle slots safely. The version 1 fixture is constructed explicitly by test_game.c.
